stories.title: PM Modi in Chennai today — projects worth over ₹13,000 crore (11 Oct)
stories.body: the PM inaugurates/dedicates and lays foundation stones across metro rail, highways, railways, ports, petroleum and education. Headliners: the Poonamallee–Vadapalani stretch of Chennai Metro Phase II (~₹4,900 crore, 3.7-km double-decker structure, signalling built for driverless operations); National Highway projects worth ~₹3,700 crore (the 36-km Vadugapatti–Therkuvenganallur section of NH-744, the 30-km Madurai Ring Road section of NH-744A, plus the foundation stone for the Thiruvarur Bypass on NH-83); and railway works of ~₹750 crore — the Karaikal–Peralam line, three rail flyovers around Coimbatore, and five redeveloped Amrit stations (Palani, Vellore Cantonment, Ambasamudram, Paramakkudi, Namakkal). The day also includes a Chennai Metro ride from Porur Bypass to Poonamallee Bypass (~11:30 AM), darshan at the Jalakandeswarar Temple (~12:15 PM), a walkthrough of the Sudha Gopalakrishnan Brain Centre at IIT Madras, and the golden jubilee of Jaigopal Garodia Hindu Vidyalaya (~3 PM).

stories.title: Lok Sabha passes the twin One Nation One Election bills (9 Oct)
stories.body: the Constitution (129th Amendment) Bill, 2026 and the Union Territories Laws (Amendment) Bill, 2026 cleared the Lok Sabha by the required two-thirds majority after a 12-hour debate. The plan: synchronise Lok Sabha and Assembly polls from 2029, with simultaneous local-body elections within 100 days. Background register: the High-Level Committee was chaired by former President Ram Nath Kovind (report 14 March 2024); amendments touch Articles 83, 85, 172, 174 and 356. The bills still need Rajya Sabha passage and ratification by at least 15 state legislatures.

stories.title: President visits the Hidimba Devi Temple, Manali
stories.body: the President offered prayers at the historic Hidimba Devi Temple in Himachal Pradesh. Exam register: the temple was constructed in 1553 during the reign of Kullu ruler Raja Bahadur Singh.

stories.title: NSO's first Q2 FY2026-27 GDP advance estimate: 7.4% (10 Oct)
stories.body: the National Statistics Office (MoSPI) put Q2 FY27 (July–September 2026) growth at 7.4% YoY at constant 2011-12 prices, up from 7.1% in Q1. Sector split: manufacturing GVA 10.3%, construction 9.1%, services 8.4%, while agriculture moderated to 3.4% on uneven monsoon in Central India.

stories.title: Global Innovation Index 2026: India at 39th (WIPO, 10 Oct)
stories.body: India rose to 39th of 132 economies (from 40th in 2025 and 81st in 2015), retaining its slot as the top innovative lower-middle-income economy for the 5th straight year and the top economy in Central and Southern Asia. Switzerland topped for the 16th consecutive year.

stories.title: SEBI notifies Settlement Regulations, 2026
stories.body: the market regulator has revised how settlement calculations and procedures work for eligible securities-market violations: settlement is pegged to a base amount referencing the minimum prescribed penalty, disgorgement of wrongful gains is treated separately (no double counting), and a fast-track mechanism applies to cases with settlement amounts of ₹10 lakh or less — factoring seriousness of violation, stage of proceedings, aggravating/mitigating circumstances and remedial measures.

stories.title: PM Dhan-Dhaanya Krishi Yojana completes one year today (11 Oct)
stories.body: approved by the Cabinet on 16 July 2025 and launched by the PM on 11 October 2025, the six-year scheme targets 100 Aspirational Agricultural Districts by converging 36 Central schemes across 11 Ministries/Departments plus State schemes and private participation. A government factsheet notes: all 100 districts have prepared District Agriculture Plans, monthly output-indicator rankings run since November 2025, and the average district score rose from 18.85 (April 2026) to 46.89 (August 2026).

stories.title: AITIGA 15th Joint Committee: next meeting January 2027 in India
stories.body: following the 6–9 October Jakarta round (covered yesterday), the committee agreed the next meeting will be held in India in January 2027 in hybrid mode. Exam register: AITIGA was signed in Bangkok in 2009 (Framework Agreement on Comprehensive Economic Cooperation traces to 2003) and entered into force on 1 January 2010; three sub-committees ran in parallel — SC-LII (legal & institutional issues), SC-NTMA (national treatment on market access) and SC-ROO (rules of origin).

stories.title: GST Council reforms: simplified compliance from April 2027
stories.body: Insights IAS flags the GST Council's compliance-simplification reforms, targeted for rollout from April 2027 — keep the timeline for prelims.

stories.title: Indian Navy to induct indigenous ASW vessel 'Mangrole'
stories.body: the Navy's next indigenous anti-submarine warfare vessel Mangrole is set for fleet induction, adding to the Make-in-India naval build-up (Insights IAS highlights its indigenous ASW capabilities). Also in the naval register: Project Seabird at Karwar continues as India's expanding western-seaboard naval base.

stories.title: NFHS-6: child marriage at 20.1% — but 2,000+ cases intercepted in Telangana alone
stories.body: Insights IAS's 10-October analysis traces the persistence of child marriage despite progress: NFHS-6 (2023–24) reports 20.1% of women aged 20–24 married before 18, down from 23.3% (NFHS-5) and 47.4% (NFHS-3). Yet field reporting shows over 2,000 child marriages intercepted in Telangana between 2025 and mid-2026 alone, with poverty, school dropouts, gender inequality and social coercion as the drivers.

stories.title: Nanda Devi Biosphere Reserve: growing landslide-prone zones
stories.body: monitoring has flagged growing landslide-prone zones inside the Nanda Devi Biosphere Reserve — a climate-vulnerability data point for Uttarakhand and a likely mains geography link.

stories.title: India to host its first World Landslide Forum (23 Nov, Faridabad)
stories.body: India will host the inaugural World Landslide Forum from 23 November in Faridabad, Haryana.

stories.title: 3rd T20 tonight (11 Oct, 7 PM, Indore)
stories.body: the five-match India–West Indies T20I series resumes at the Holkar Stadium, Indore with the series level 1–1 after India's Lucknow win (6 Oct) and West Indies' record 252/4 chase in Ranchi (9 Oct; Shai Hope 102* off 45). Remaining: 4th T20 on 14 Oct (Hyderabad), 5th on 17 Oct (Bengaluru).

stories.title: IOA elections on 5 December
stories.body: Indian Olympic Association chief P.T. Usha announced the IOA elections for 5 December, calling the process a milestone of good governance.

stories.title: Oil tanker attacked at Sharjah Anchorage — all Indian crew safe
stories.body: Union Minister Sarbananda Sonowal said all Indian crew members are safe after an oil tanker was attacked at the Sharjah Anchorage.

stories.title: Magnitude 7.6 earthquake hits Panama (USGS)
stories.body: a 7.6-magnitude quake struck Panama — the biggest global seismic event of the day.

one_liners: PM in Chennai (11 Oct): projects over ₹13,000 crore; Chennai Metro Phase II Poonamallee–Vadapalani ~₹4,900 cr (3.7-km double-decker, driverless-ready signalling); highways ~₹3,700 cr (NH-744 Vadugapatti–Therkuvenganallur 36 km; NH-744A Madurai Ring Road 30 km; Thiruvarur Bypass on NH-83); railways ~₹750 cr (Karaikal–Peralam line; 3 Coimbatore flyovers; 5 Amrit stations — Palani, Vellore Cantonment, Ambasamudram, Paramakkudi, Namakkal); Metro ride ~11:30 AM, Jalakandeswarar Temple ~12:15 PM, Brain Centre at IIT Madras, school golden jubilee ~3 PM.

ONOE bills (9 Oct): Constitution (129th Amendment) Bill, 2026 + UT Laws (Amendment) Bill, 2026 passed by Lok Sabha (2/3 majority, 12-hour debate); sync from 2029, local bodies within 100 days; Kovind committee report 14 March 2024; Articles 83, 85, 172, 174, 356; Rajya Sabha + 15 state legislatures still needed.
President at Hidimba Devi Temple, Manali: temple built 1553 under Kullu ruler Raja Bahadur Singh.
NSO (10 Oct): Q2 FY2026-27 first advance estimate — GDP 7.4% (Q1 was 7.1%); manufacturing 10.3%, construction 9.1%, services 8.4%, agriculture 3.4%; constant 2011-12 prices, MoSPI.
GII 2026 (WIPO, 10 Oct): India 39th/132 (40th in 2025, 81st in 2015); top lower-middle-income economy 5th year running; top in Central & Southern Asia; Switzerland 16th year at top.
SEBI Settlement Regulations, 2026: fast-track for settlement amounts ₹10 lakh or less; base amount = minimum prescribed penalty; disgorgement separate — no double counting.

PM Dhan-Dhaanya Krishi Yojana: completes one year today; Cabinet approval 16 July 2025, PM launch 11 October 2025; 100 Aspirational Agricultural Districts; 36 Central schemes, 11 Ministries; district scores 18.85 → 46.89 (Apr–Aug 2026).
AITIGA: 15th JC was 6–9 Oct, Jakarta; next: January 2027 in India (hybrid); signed 2009, Bangkok; in force 1 January 2010; sub-committees SC-LII, SC-NTMA, SC-ROO.
Defence: Navy to induct indigenous ASW vessel 'Mangrole'; Project Seabird, Karwar in the register.
Society: NFHS-6 — 20.1% of women 20–24 married before 18 (23.3% NFHS-5; 47.4% NFHS-3); 2,000+ child marriages intercepted in Telangana (2025–mid-2026).
Environment: Nanda Devi Biosphere Reserve — growing landslide-prone zones; India hosts first World Landslide Forum from 23 Nov in Faridabad.
Sports: 3rd T20 today, 7 PM, Holkar Stadium, Indore — series 1–1; 4th T20 14 Oct Hyderabad, 5th 17 Oct Bengaluru; IOA elections 5 December (P.T. Usha).
International: Sharjah Anchorage tanker attack — all Indian crew safe (Sarbananda Sonowal); Panama hit by M7.6 quake (USGS).
Important days: 11 Oct — International Day of the Girl Child; National Postal Week 9–15 Oct; 13 Oct — International Day for Disaster Risk Reduction.
